final_message:
Completed the standard-depth PubMed strategy with the required 2015-03-27 cutoff. The final query is saved as a single line in [final_strategy.txt](/abs/C:/Users/aaron/AppData/Local/Temp/psb-evals/run-f0c52b41b3ed9d0d/ours-codex-noseed-20260927T144256Z/final_strategy.txt); the full audit and assumptions are in [audit.md](/abs/C:/Users/aaron/AppData/Local/Temp/psb-evals/run-f0c52b41b3ed9d0d/ours-codex-noseed-20260927T144256Z/work/audit.md).

The strategy returned 1,880 records. It retrieved all 18 screened development records, but there was no independent benchmark, so that relative recall does not establish sensitivity. The internal PRESS-structured critique has no open must-fix findings; an information specialist’s PRESS peer review is still needed before use.
